_comment: Rules of skill E. A rule computes only if VERIFIED-REOPENED. Passages recorded in references/method-standards.md. No published standard exists for burn-rate or runway calculation; the burn-basis rule is an engineering rule of this skill. Grounding lane (7 November 2026; deepen 8 November 2026): every enabled rule carries passage_ids. REFUSE ENABLE: FIN-ASC205-40-ISSUE stays SUMMARY-ONLY / disabled with empty passage_ids even after E3 PARTIAL ASU dual-read — Codification dual-read + owner yes still required before any enable.

rules.passage: 17 CFR 229.303(b)(1) (eCFR, opened in full 7 Nov 2026): "the short-term (i.e., the next 12 months from the most recent fiscal period end required to be presented) and separately in the long-term (i.e., beyond the next 12 months)". Item 303(b)(1)(i): "If a material deficiency is identified, indicate the course of action that the registrant has taken or proposes to take to remedy the deficiency."

PCAOB AS 2415.02 (opened in full 7 Nov 2026): the auditor evaluates "whether there is substantial doubt about the entity's ability to continue as a going concern for a reasonable period of time, not to exceed one year beyond the date of the financial statements being audited".

FASB ASC 205-40 / ASU 2014-15 management look-ahead of one year after issuance: ASU 2014-15 text was dual-read via a PwC Viewpoint host (E3 PARTIAL; VP-E-060/061 registered for documentation only). FASB Codification Basic View remains unauthorized. REFUSE ENABLE — this rule stays SUMMARY-ONLY / disabled; do not attach passage_ids or compute the issuance-based horizon until Codification dual-read + owner yes.
rules.disabled_message: [CHECK] management's look-ahead (ASC 205-40) is not applied; the filed going-concern language is read as written
rules.enable_gate: Codification dual-read of ASC 205-40 + explicit owner enable; ASU host PARTIAL alone is insufficient

rules.passage: 26 U.S.C. 382(g)(1) (Cornell LII, opened in full 7 Nov 2026): an ownership change exists if "the percentage of the stock of the loss corporation owned by 1 or more 5-percent shareholders has increased by more than 50 percentage points, over (B) the lowest percentage of stock of the loss corporation ... owned by such shareholders at any time during the testing period".
26 U.S.C. 382(i)(1): "the testing period is the 3-year period ending on the day of any owner shift involving a 5-percent shareholder or equity structure shift".

26 U.S.C. 382(b)(1): "the section 382 limitation for any post-change year is an amount equal to (A) the value of the old loss corporation, multiplied by (B) the long-term tax-exempt rate." The rate itself is published separately and was not opened; the script does not compute the limitation.

26 U.S.C. 172(a)(2)(B)(ii) (govinfo, 2024 edition): for losses arising in taxable years beginning after 31 December 2017 the deduction is limited to 80 percent of taxable income computed without regard to that deduction. Flag only; a tax specialist decides.

Regulation S-K Item 601(b)(10)(iv): a registrant may redact specific provisions or terms of material-contract exhibits if it customarily and actually treats them as private or confidential and they are not material; the Commission may require the information to be included. A redacted milestone or royalty term is a GAP with a request for the unredacted agreement.
